# Meta-clustering characterization

## Meta-clustering

```{r eval = FALSE}

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(metasnf)
library(abcdutils)
library(ggplot2)

proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))
#
eom_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_21_eom_0_0_train.csv"))
#eom_fair_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_21_eom_fair_0_0_train.csv"))
#
min(eom_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 5.2069e-14
min(eom_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.002912379
#
#min(eom_fair_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 1.182735e-08
#min(eom_fair_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.008627628
#
# Identify the lowest p-value solutions for each number of subtypes
top_oms_0_0_train <- top_om_per_cluster(eom_0_0_train)
top_oms_0_0_train |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))

write_csv(top_oms_0_0_train, proc_path("top_oms_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

om_scatter(
    top_oms_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path(
        "top_oms_0_0_train_scatter.png",
        date = TRUE
    )
)

mc_results_0_0_train <- meta_cluster(eom_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

mc_results_0_0_train <-
    as.matrix(read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_21_mc_results_0_0_train.csv")))

colnames(mc_results_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))

# ARIs between solutions
ari_heatmap(mc_results_0_0_train,
           save = fig_path("mc_results_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE))

## Trying to plot the input design matrix as a heatmap
mc_order_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(mc_results_0_0_train)

## Design matrix
design_matrix <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_20_design_matrix.csv"))

dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix,
    fig_path("dm_original_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE)
)

dm_heatmap(design_matrix[mc_order_0_0_train, ],
           fig_path("dm_reordered_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))

dm_heatmap(design_matrix[mc_order_0_0_train, ],
           manuscript_path("dm_reordered_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))


mc_pvals_0_0_train <- p_val_select(om_0_0_train)

mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train <- mc_pvals_0_0_train[mc_order_0_0_train, ]

# P-values
pvals_pheatmap(mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train,
               save = fig_path("mc_pvals_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))

pvals_pheatmap(mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train,
               save = manuscript_path("mc_pvals_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))
```
